lines.text: And across the ocean, a Danish company called Novo Nordisk started this whole boom with Ozempic and Wegovy.

lines.text: So how do two drug companies turn one weekly shot into one of the biggest money machines in medicine?

lines.text: Chapter 1: From lizard to blockbuster
lines.say: Chapter one: from lizard to blockbuster.

lines.text: Start with your gut. After you eat, it releases a hormone called GLP-1.
lines.say: Start with your gut. After you eat, it releases a hormone called G L P one.

lines.text: It helps control blood sugar, slows how fast your stomach empties, and tells your brain you're full.
lines.say: It helps control blood sugar, slows how fast your stomach empties, and tells your brain you're full.

lines.text: The catch: your body breaks it down in minutes. So for decades, it was hard to turn into a medicine.
lines.say: The catch: your body breaks it down in minutes. So for decades, it was hard to turn into a medicine.

lines.text: The fix came from a strange place. In 1992, a VA researcher named John Eng found a similar hormone in Gila monster venom.
lines.say: The fix came from a strange place. In nineteen ninety-two, a V A researcher named John Eng found a similar hormone in Gila monster venom.

lines.text: A lab-made copy, exenatide, lasted much longer than our own GLP-1. As Byetta, it became the first GLP-1 drug, approved in 2005 for diabetes.
lines.say: A lab-made copy, exenatide, lasted much longer than our own G L P one. As Byetta, it became the first G L P one drug, approved in two thousand five for diabetes.

lines.text: Novo Nordisk engineered its own long-lasting version of the human hormone, semaglutide. As Ozempic, it was approved for type 2 diabetes in 2017.
lines.say: Novo Nordisk engineered its own long-lasting version of the human hormone, semaglutide. As Ozempic, it was approved for type two diabetes in twenty seventeen.

lines.text: Patients on it kept losing weight. So Novo tested a higher dose for obesity, and in 2021 it was approved as Wegovy.
lines.say: Patients on it kept losing weight. So Novo tested a higher dose for obesity, and in twenty twenty-one it was approved as Wegovy.

lines.text: In its main trial, people on Wegovy lost 14.9% of their body weight on average over 68 weeks, versus 2.4% on a placebo.
lines.say: In its main trial, people on Wegovy lost fourteen point nine percent of their body weight on average over sixty-eight weeks, versus two point four percent on a placebo.

lines.text: Then Lilly arrived with tirzepatide, which copies two gut hormones instead of one.
lines.say: Then Lilly arrived with tirzepatide, which copies two gut hormones instead of one.

lines.text: It was approved for diabetes as Mounjaro in 2022, and for weight loss as Zepbound in 2023.
lines.say: It was approved for diabetes as Mounjaro in twenty twenty-two, and for weight loss as Zepbound in twenty twenty-three.

lines.text: In its main trial, the top dose averaged 20.9% weight loss over 72 weeks. The trials weren't head to head, but the gap got noticed.
lines.say: In its main trial, the top dose averaged twenty point nine percent weight loss over seventy-two weeks. The trials weren't head to head, but the gap got noticed.

lines.text: And in 2026, both companies added weight-loss pills: Novo's Wegovy pill in January, Lilly's Foundayo in April.
lines.say: And in twenty twenty-six, both companies added weight-loss pills: Novo's Wegovy pill in January, Lilly's Foundayo in April.

lines.text: Chapter 2: One molecule, two price tags
lines.say: Chapter two: one molecule, two price tags.

lines.text: Here's the clever part. Each company sells one molecule under two brand names.
lines.say: Here's the clever part. Each company sells one molecule under two brand names.

lines.text: Novo's semaglutide is Ozempic for diabetes,
lines.say: Novo's semaglutide is Ozempic for diabetes,

lines.text: and Wegovy for weight loss.
lines.say: and Wegovy for weight loss.

lines.text: Lilly's tirzepatide is Mounjaro for diabetes,
lines.say: Lilly's tirzepatide is Mounjaro for diabetes,

lines.text: and Zepbound for weight loss.
lines.say: and Zepbound for weight loss.

lines.text: Why bother? Because each brand gets its own approval, its own label, and its own deal with insurers.
lines.say: Why bother? Because each brand gets its own approval, its own label, and its own deal with insurers.

lines.text: Many insurance plans cover diabetes drugs but not weight-loss drugs. Two brands let each company sell into both worlds.
lines.say: Many insurance plans cover diabetes drugs but not weight-loss drugs. Two brands let each company sell into both worlds.

lines.text: Now the price. In early 2026, Wegovy's US list price was about $1,349 a month.
lines.say: Now the price. In early twenty twenty-six, Wegovy's US list price was about one thousand three hundred forty-nine dollars a month.

lines.text: That's $16,188 a year, by our math. But list price is a starting point, not what most people pay.
lines.say: That's sixteen thousand one hundred eighty-eight dollars a year, by our math. But list price is a starting point, not what most people pay.

lines.text: Insurers and middlemen negotiate rebates off that number, and the companies don't publish what they really get.
lines.say: Insurers and middlemen negotiate rebates off that number, and the companies don't publish what they really get.

lines.text: So both companies opened a second door: selling directly to people paying cash.
lines.say: So both companies opened a second door: selling directly to people paying cash.

lines.text: From December 2025, Lilly's own LillyDirect pharmacy sold Zepbound vials for $299 to $449 a month, depending on the dose.
lines.say: From December twenty twenty-five, Lilly's own Lilly Direct pharmacy sold Zepbound vials for two hundred ninety-nine to four hundred forty-nine dollars a month, depending on the dose.

lines.text: At the top dose, that's $5,388 a year, by our math. Still a lot, but about a third of Wegovy's list price.
lines.say: At the top dose, that's five thousand three hundred eighty-eight dollars a year, by our math. Still a lot, but about a third of Wegovy's list price.

lines.text: Novo did the same through its own pharmacy. In late 2025, new cash-pay patients could start Wegovy at an introductory $199 a month.
lines.say: Novo did the same through its own pharmacy. In late twenty twenty-five, new cash-pay patients could start Wegovy at an introductory one hundred ninety-nine dollars a month.

lines.text: So what does a dose cost to make? Novo doesn't say. A 2024 Yale-led study estimated semaglutide could be made for under $5 a month.
lines.say: So what does a dose cost to make? Novo doesn't say. A twenty twenty-four Yale-led study estimated semaglutide could be made for under five dollars a month.

lines.text: That estimate leaves out research, failed trials and giant factories, which cost billions. But it shows where the profit lives: in the patent.
lines.say: That estimate leaves out research, failed trials and giant factories, which cost billions. But it shows where the profit lives: in the patent.

lines.text: Chapter 3: The money race
lines.say: Chapter three: the money race.

lines.text: Here's Lilly's total revenue from 2019 to 2025, from its annual reports.
lines.say: Here's Lilly's total revenue from twenty nineteen to twenty twenty-five, from its annual reports.

lines.text: It grew slowly for years, to $28.5 billion in 2022. Then Mounjaro and Zepbound took off.
lines.say: It grew slowly for years, to twenty-eight point five billion dollars in twenty twenty-two. Then Mounjaro and Zepbound took off.

lines.text: By 2025 it hit $65.2 billion. That's about 2.3 times as much in three years, by our math.
lines.say: By twenty twenty-five it hit sixty-five point two billion. That's about two point three times as much in three years, by our math.

lines.text: In 2025, Mounjaro made $23.0 billion and Zepbound made $13.5 billion.
lines.say: In twenty twenty-five, Mounjaro made twenty-three billion dollars and Zepbound made thirteen point five billion.

lines.text: Together, that's 56% of everything Lilly sold that year, by our math.
lines.say: Together, that's about fifty-six percent of everything Lilly sold that year, by our math.

lines.text: And Lilly's share kept climbing. In July to September 2026, the same drug was about 66% of Lilly revenue, or two of every three dollars.
lines.say: And Lilly's share kept climbing. In July to September twenty twenty-six, the same drug was about sixty-six percent of Lilly revenue, or two of every three dollars.

lines.text: Now Novo. Here are its sales in Danish kroner, 2019 to 2025.
lines.say: Now Novo. Here are its sales in Danish kroner, twenty nineteen to twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: Novo got there first. Sales jumped from 177 billion kroner in 2022 to 290 billion in 2024.
lines.say: Novo got there first. Sales jumped from about one hundred seventy-seven billion kroner in twenty twenty-two to about two hundred ninety billion in twenty twenty-four.

lines.text: Then the line flattened. In 2025, sales grew just 6% in kroner, to 309 billion, or roughly $47 billion.
lines.say: Then the line flattened. In twenty twenty-five, sales grew just six percent in kroner, to three hundred nine billion, or roughly forty-seven billion dollars.

lines.text: Its obesity business went from about 6 billion kroner in 2019 to 82 billion in 2025, Novo said. That's roughly 14 times.
lines.say: Its obesity business went from about six billion kroner in twenty nineteen to eighty-two billion in twenty twenty-five, Novo said. That's roughly fourteen times.

lines.text: But by 2026 its biggest shots were slipping. In July to September, Ozempic sales fell 5% and Wegovy shots fell 2%, at constant currency.
lines.say: But by twenty twenty-six its biggest shots were slipping. In July to September, Ozempic sales fell five percent and Wegovy shots fell two percent, at constant currency.

lines.text: The new Wegovy pill helped. It brought in 5.4 billion kroner that quarter, about $800 million.
lines.say: The new Wegovy pill helped. It brought in five point four billion kroner that quarter, about eight hundred million dollars.

lines.text: On its October 2026 call, Lilly said about 6 of every 10 US prescriptions for obesity drugs like these were for its medicines.
lines.say: On its October twenty twenty-six call, Lilly said about six of every ten US prescriptions for obesity drugs like these were for its medicines.

lines.text: Novo counters that the Wegovy brand wins over half of new US patients starting branded obesity drugs. Different yardsticks, same fierce race.
lines.say: Novo counters that the Wegovy brand wins over half of new US patients starting branded obesity drugs. Different yardsticks, same fierce race.

lines.text: One more twist: Novo is controlled by a charity. The Novo Nordisk Foundation holds about 28% of the shares but about 77% of the votes.
lines.say: One more twist: Novo is controlled by a charity. The Novo Nordisk Foundation holds about twenty-eight percent of the shares but about seventy-seven percent of the votes.

lines.text: Its special shares carry 10 times the votes. So the foundation, not Wall Street, has the final say.
lines.say: Its special shares carry ten times the votes. So the foundation, not Wall Street, has the final say.

lines.text: Chapter 4: Prices down, volume up
lines.say: Chapter four: prices down, volume up.

lines.text: Here's the strange math of this boom. Prices are falling, and revenue is still soaring.
lines.say: Here's the strange math of this boom. Prices are falling, and revenue is still soaring.

lines.text: In July to September 2026, Lilly said its US prices fell 7%, but the amount it sold jumped 41%.
lines.say: In July to September twenty twenty-six, Lilly said its US prices fell seven percent, but the amount it sold jumped forty-one percent.

lines.text: Outside the US it was even more extreme: prices down 29%, volume up 76%, partly tied to Mounjaro getting covered in China.
lines.say: Outside the US it was even more extreme: prices down twenty-nine percent, volume up seventy-six percent, partly tied to Mounjaro getting covered in China.

lines.text: The idea is simple. Cut the price, reach millions more people, and make it up on volume.
lines.say: The idea is simple. Cut the price, reach millions more people, and make it up on volume.

lines.text: Washington pushed too. In November 2025, both companies reached deals with the Trump administration on prices.
lines.say: Washington pushed too. In November twenty twenty-five, both companies reached deals with the Trump administration on prices.

lines.text: Under those deals, Medicare and Medicaid would pay $245 a month, with a $50 copay for eligible Medicare patients.
lines.say: Under those deals, Medicare and Medicaid would pay two hundred forty-five dollars a month, with a fifty-dollar copay for eligible Medicare patients.

lines.text: Supporters call it wider access. Critics question the terms. Either way, the drugmakers traded price for reach.
lines.say: Supporters call it wider access. Critics question the terms. Either way, the drugmakers traded price for reach.

lines.text: Then Novo went further. Starting January 2027, Wegovy's US list price is $675 a month, about half the old price.
lines.say: Then Novo went further. Starting January twenty twenty-seven, Wegovy's US list price is six hundred seventy-five dollars a month, about half the old price.

lines.text: Ozempic's list price is $675 too, about 35% lower, Novo said.
lines.say: Ozempic's list price is six hundred seventy-five dollars too, about thirty-five percent lower, Novo said.

lines.text: Separately, Medicare's own negotiation set a $274 monthly price for Ozempic and Wegovy, starting in 2027.
lines.say: Separately, Medicare's own negotiation set a two hundred seventy-four dollar monthly price for Ozempic and Wegovy, starting in twenty twenty-seven.

lines.text: Pills opened another cheaper door. Lilly's Foundayo launched at $149 a month for the starting dose with cash pay.
lines.say: Pills opened another cheaper door. Lilly's Foundayo launched at one hundred forty-nine dollars a month for the starting dose with cash pay.

lines.text: Even with prices falling, Lilly raised its 2026 revenue forecast to $91 to $92 billion in October.
lines.say: Even with prices falling, Lilly raised its twenty twenty-six revenue forecast to ninety-one to ninety-two billion dollars in October.

lines.text: Novo, meanwhile, said in November that its 2026 adjusted sales would land between down 2% and up 2%, at constant currency.
lines.say: Novo, meanwhile, said in November that its twenty twenty-six adjusted sales would land between down two percent and up two percent, at constant currency.

lines.text: Chapter 5: The risks
lines.say: Chapter five: the risks.

lines.text: Risk number one: supply. Starting in 2022, demand got so high that the FDA listed both drugs as in shortage.
lines.say: Risk number one: supply. Starting in twenty twenty-two, demand got so high that the F D A listed both drugs as in shortage.

lines.text: That let compounding pharmacies sell cheaper copies. Once the FDA declared the shortages over, in late 2024 and early 2025, most of that had to stop.
lines.say: That let compounding pharmacies sell cheaper copies. Once the F D A declared the shortages over, in late twenty twenty-four and early twenty twenty-five, most of that had to stop.

lines.text: Risk number two: patents. A patent is a time limit on the monopoly.
lines.say: Risk number two: patents. A patent is a time limit on the monopoly.

lines.text: In 2026, semaglutide's key patents ended in Canada, China, India and Brazil, opening the door to cheaper generic copies.
lines.say: In twenty twenty-six, semaglutide's key patents ended in Canada, China, India and Brazil, opening the door to cheaper generic copies.

lines.text: In the US, semaglutide's main patent runs to about 2031 or 2032, and tirzepatide's to 2036, according to patent trackers.
lines.say: In the US, semaglutide's main patent runs to about twenty thirty-one or twenty thirty-two, and tirzepatide's to twenty thirty-six, according to patent trackers.

lines.text: That gap matters. Novo hits the patent wall in the US years before Lilly does.
lines.say: That gap matters. Novo hits the patent wall in the US years before Lilly does.

lines.text: Risk number three: side effects. On the labels, the most common are nausea, diarrhea, vomiting and constipation.
lines.say: Risk number three: side effects. On the labels, the most common are nausea, diarrhea, vomiting and constipation.

lines.text: The FDA labels list more serious warnings too, which is a conversation for a doctor, not a finance channel.
lines.say: The F D A labels list more serious warnings too, which is a conversation for a doctor, not a finance channel.

lines.text: Risk number four: stopping. In a follow-up to Wegovy's trial, people regained about two-thirds of the lost weight within a year of quitting.
lines.say: Risk number four: stopping. In a follow-up to Wegovy's trial, people regained about two-thirds of the lost weight within a year of quitting.

lines.text: For patients, that's a real limit. For the business, it means many customers stay on the drug for years.
lines.say: For patients, that's a real limit. For the business, it means many customers stay on the drug for years.

lines.text: And competition can hit hard. Novo's head count fell from about 77,300 in 2024 to 69,500 in 2025, after it announced about 9,000 job cuts.
lines.say: And competition can hit hard. Novo's head count fell from about seventy-seven thousand three hundred in twenty twenty-four to sixty-nine thousand five hundred in twenty twenty-five, after it announced about nine thousand job cuts.

lines.text: From boom to cost cutting in about a year. That's how fast leadership can change in this market.
lines.say: From boom to cost cutting in about a year. That's how fast leadership can change in this market.

lines.text: Chapter 6: What it all means
lines.say: Chapter six: what it all means.

lines.text: So here's how this boom makes money. First, a gut hormone, made to last a week.
lines.say: So here's how this boom makes money. First, a gut hormone, made to last a week.

lines.text: Second, one molecule sold under two brands, to reach both diabetes and weight-loss patients.
lines.say: Second, one molecule sold under two brands, to reach both diabetes and weight-loss patients.

lines.text: Third, lower prices for far more people, through cash sales, government deals and pills.
lines.say: Third, lower prices for far more people, through cash sales, government deals and pills.

lines.text: And fourth, a patent clock that decides how long the big profits last.
lines.say: And fourth, a patent clock that decides how long the big profits last.

lines.text: For customers, the trend through 2026 was lower prices and more ways to buy, though still hundreds of dollars a month for many.
lines.say: For customers, the trend through twenty twenty-six was lower prices and more ways to buy, though still hundreds of dollars a month for many.

lines.text: And for the drugmakers, it added up to $16 billion in three months from one Lilly molecule alone.
lines.say: And for the drugmakers, it added up to sixteen billion dollars in three months from one Lilly molecule alone.

lines.text: A hormone from your gut, with help from a lizard, built one of the biggest businesses in medicine.

post.title: The Weight-Loss Shot That Made $16 Billion in 3 Months: How Ozempic and Zepbound Pay
post.ig: One weight-loss molecule made Lilly $16 billion in three months of 2026. Here's how the GLP-1 boom really makes money.
post.tiktok: Mounjaro plus Zepbound made $16.1B in Jul-Sep 2026. Two brands, one drug, and a price war, explained.
post.yt_desc:
From July to September 2026, Eli Lilly's tirzepatide, sold as Mounjaro and Zepbound, brought in $16.1 billion, about $175 million a day by our math. This video explains where GLP-1 drugs came from (yes, a Gila monster is involved), why Novo Nordisk and Lilly each sell one molecule under two brand names, how list prices, rebates and cash-pay channels work, and why prices are falling while sales soar. We chart Lilly's and Novo Nordisk's sales from 2019 to 2025 and look at the risks: shortages, patents ending abroad in 2026, side effects and what happens when people stop.
